title: Bilateral mini-squat technique
subdomain: Initial partial-squat technique in knee rehabilitation, not a universal depth limit for all squats.
summary: The initial partial-squat technique bends both knees into a 30-to-45-degree flexion range and then extends them. It cues an upright trunk, posterior weight shift and lowering the hips as if sitting. Elastic resistance or handheld weights are progressions, not requirements for the basic variation.
